S3500 Series L3 Managed Switches
- S3508: 8*100/1000M/2.5GBase-T and 4*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3508PB-4X: 8*100/1000M/2.5G PoE+( (Max45W/port)) Base-T and 4*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3524-6X: 24*100/1000M/2.5G Base-T and 6*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3524-6X-D: 24*100/1000M/2.5G Base-T and 6*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3524P-6X: 24*100/1000M/2.5G POE++ (Max 90W/port) Base-T and 6*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3524PB-6X: 24*100/1000M/2.5G POE++ (Max 90W/port) Base-T and 6*10G SFP+ Uplink
- S3508 / S3508PB-4X: 1*AC100-240V power supply

- S3524-6X-D: 3*Fixed fan, 2*150W AC power supply
- S3524-6X: 4*Fixed fan, 1*96W AC power supply
- S3524P-6X: 5*Fixed fan, 1*450W AC power supply
- S3524PB-6X: 5*Fixed fan, 1*880W AC power supply
OVERVIEW

S3524 Series routing switches, high-performance Layer 3 Ethernet switch with 2.5G Multi-Gigabit and 10G SFP+ Ports compact 1U form factor. The HOS delivers robust feature support，Provide Layer 3 network features.
Built from the ground up with the combination of advanced hardware and software, the switch provides a Layer 3 routing solution for next generation SMB / Enterprise / Wi-Fi 6 AX Access/ high speed NAS networks.
Varied Port Types
Support 10M/100M/1G /2.5G /10G ports to meet different network requirements.
Ultra-Long-Distance PoE++
Optical-electrical synergy, implementing 300 m PoE+ (90W /Port) and 10 Gbit/s access for Wi-Fi 6 Aps and other PDs. Compatible 802.3af/at/bt standard.
